question.text: For how many assessment years can a business loss from exchange-traded derivatives trading be carried forward under the Income-tax Act, provided the return of income is filed on time?

explanation.text: The Logic: Page 217 states: "The unabsorbed loss can be carried forward up to 8 assessment years. It can be set off only against the business income in the subsequent years. It is important to note that the assessee is entitled to carry forward the business loss provided the return of income is filed on or before the due date." The Trap: Filing the return after the due date forfeits the carry-forward benefit, even though the 8-year window otherwise applies. Note: Carry-forward in subsequent years is permitted only against business income, not against other heads.
